description: Use this when the domain the user wants is taken (or they ask for other options for a name). Given a full domain like "acme.com", proposes other endings (acme.io), added words (getacme.com), domain hacks and related words, checks every candidate live, and returns only the ones that are not taken. Slower than a single check (up to ~30 live lookups).

domain.description: The full domain the user wanted, e.g. "acme.com" or "stripe.io"

name: suggest_tld_alternatives
title: Suggest alternative domains
